components.text: Note: this system was redesigned from earlier versions of the mod. The old graph of Master/Input/Output/Filter nodes wired together by hand with a Node Router wand is gone - nodes now connect automatically to any other routing-node block touching them, with no separate linking tool or per-face connection GUI. The Filter item system itself (see the Filters entry) is back, though, and plugs directly into these nodes.

A Routing Node network has three block types: the Master Routing Node, Input Routing Nodes, and Output Routing Nodes. Every network needs exactly one Master Routing Node, which discovers the rest of the connected nodes for you.

Input Routing Nodes pull items from any adjacent external inventory into the network. Output Routing Nodes push items out into whichever adjacent inventory you've designated, ordered by priority (higher priority nodes are filled first) - right-click empty-handed to cycle priority, sneak-right-click empty-handed to flip its built-in whitelist/blacklist mode.

Both node types also accept a Filter item: right-click the node with a Filter item in hand to install it (sneak-right-click empty-handed to remove it again). An installed Filter adds tag/mod id/enchantment/composite matching on top of whatever built-in filtering the node already has - both have to agree for an item to pass.
